description: Grace, Princess of Monaco (born Grace Patricia Kelly) (French pronunciation: [ɡʁas patʁisja keli] November 12, 1929 – September 14, 1982) was an American actress and Princess of Monaco as the wife of Prince Rainier III from their marriage on April 18, 1956 until her death in 1982. Prior to her marriage, she achieved stardom in several significant Hollywood films in the early to mid-1950s.
